title: When a product of bits equals one
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite index set, and assign to each $i\in\iota$ an element $x_i$ of the two-element set with multiplication modulo $2$. The product $\prod_{i\in\iota}x_i$ equals $1$ if and only if every $x_i$ equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns an element of the two-element set to each index
